newsitem.title: USA: Spain's Rato praises Italian economic efforts.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato praises Italian economic efforts.

text.p: Spanish Deputy Prime Minister Rodrigo Rato Tuesday praised Italy's economic policy, saying the country was making a "great effort' to reduce its budget deficit and bring down inflation.
"The strategy of the Italian government is profound and decisive," he told reporters at the annual meeting of the International Monetary Fund and World Bnak.
He said that Spain's Europen Union partners increasingly recognized the efforts his country was making to become a founding member of European Monetary Union in 1999.
"There is a growing consensus that Spain is making the correct efforts to belong to EMU in 1999," Rato, who is also Economy Minister, said.
